queries.cypher: MATCH (n:ICEntity) RETURN n.id AS id, n.key AS key, n.kind AS kind, n.label AS label, n.data AS data LIMIT 300
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:RESOLVES_TO]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:USES_RESOURCE]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:SELECTS]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:REQUIRES]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:HOSTED_BY]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (n:ICEntity {id:$id}) RETURN n.graphVersion AS version LIMIT 1
MATCH (a:ICEntity {id:$id})-[:RESOLVES_TO*1..1]->(s:ICEntity) RETURN s.id AS id, s.key AS key, s.kind AS kind, s.label AS label, s.data AS data LIMIT 2
MATCH (s:ICEntity {id:$id})-[:USES_RESOURCE*1..1]->(r:ICEntity) RETURN r.id AS id, r.key AS key, r.kind AS kind, r.label AS label, r.data AS data LIMIT 2
MATCH (r:ICEntity {id:$root})-[:HAS_SESSION]->(s:ICSession {id:$id}) RETURN s.id AS id, s.key AS key, s.kind AS kind, s.label AS label, s.data AS data LIMIT 1
MATCH (r:ICEntity {id:$root}) RETURN r.graphVersion AS version LIMIT 1
MATCH (s:ICSession {id:$id})-[:REMEMBERS_SERVICE]->(n:ICEntity) RETURN n.id AS id, n.key AS key, n.kind AS kind, n.label AS label LIMIT 20
MATCH (n:ICEntity {key:$key}) RETURN n.id AS id LIMIT 1
MATCH (r:ICEntity {id:$root})-[:HAS_SESSION]->(s:ICSession {id:$id}) RETURN s.id AS id, s.key AS key, s.kind AS kind, s.label AS label, s.data AS data LIMIT 1
MATCH (r:ICEntity {id:$root}) RETURN r.graphVersion AS version LIMIT 1
MATCH (s:ICSession {id:$id})-[:REMEMBERS_SERVICE]->(n:ICEntity) RETURN n.id AS id, n.key AS key, n.kind AS kind, n.label AS label LIMIT 20

queries.cypher: MATCH (n:ICEntity) RETURN n.id AS id, n.key AS key, n.kind AS kind, n.label AS label, n.data AS data LIMIT 300
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:RESOLVES_TO]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:USES_RESOURCE]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:SELECTS]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:REQUIRES]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (a:ICEntity)-[:HOSTED_BY]->(b:ICEntity) RETURN a.id AS src, b.id AS dst LIMIT 500
MATCH (n:ICEntity {id:$id}) RETURN n.graphVersion AS version LIMIT 1
MATCH (a:ICEntity {id:$id})-[:RESOLVES_TO*1..1]->(s:ICEntity) RETURN s.id AS id, s.key AS key, s.kind AS kind, s.label AS label, s.data AS data LIMIT 2
MATCH (s:ICEntity {id:$id})-[:USES_RESOURCE*1..1]->(r:ICEntity) RETURN r.id AS id, r.key AS key, r.kind AS kind, r.label AS label, r.data AS data LIMIT 2
MATCH (r:ICEntity {id:$root})-[:HAS_SESSION]->(s:ICSession {id:$id}) RETURN s.id AS id, s.key AS key, s.kind AS kind, s.label AS label, s.data AS data LIMIT 1
MATCH (r:ICEntity {id:$root}) RETURN r.graphVersion AS version LIMIT 1
MATCH (s:ICSession {id:$id})-[:REMEMBERS_SERVICE]->(n:ICEntity) RETURN n.id AS id, n.key AS key, n.kind AS kind, n.label AS label LIMIT 20
MATCH (n:ICEntity {key:$key}) RETURN n.id AS id LIMIT 1
MATCH (r:ICEntity {id:$root})-[:HAS_SESSION]->(s:ICSession {id:$id}) RETURN s.id AS id, s.key AS key, s.kind AS kind, s.label AS label, s.data AS data LIMIT 1
MATCH (r:ICEntity {id:$root}) RETURN r.graphVersion AS version LIMIT 1
MATCH (s:ICSession {id:$id})-[:REMEMBERS_SERVICE]->(n:ICEntity) RETURN n.id AS id, n.key AS key, n.kind AS kind, n.label AS label LIMIT 20
